title: Valid Parentheses
description:
Given a string $s$ consisting of characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string has valid (balanced) brackets.

A string is valid if:
- Open brackets are closed by the same type of brackets.
- Open brackets are closed in the correct order.
- Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type.
inputFormat: The first line contains a single string $s$ ($1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$) consisting of characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']'.
outputFormat: Print "YES" if the string has valid brackets, "NO" otherwise.
constraints:
$1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$
The string consists only of bracket characters: ()[]{}
